entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.english: The electronic cargo information has been received
entries.note: The platform writes this row itself for an order without scans, on its creation time. The English is the row's on BYHD's tracker.

entries.wording: Shipment information received
Shipment information sent to FedEx
entries.note: The label's data passed to FedEx, which delivers the last leg, before JRT's first scan.

entries.wording: The cargo has been picked up and arrived at the warehouse，awaiting outbound shipment
entries.note: Collected after the destination's clearance and at JRT's warehouse there, before the hand-over to the delivering carrier. It is not the first acceptance.

entries.wording: It has been handed over to the service provider.
entries.note: Handed to the delivering carrier, such as FedEx, after the clearance. It is not the first acceptance.

entries.wording: On the way
entries.note: Copied from FedEx, which delivers the last leg: moving between its facilities.

entries.wording: Departed FedEx hub
entries.note: Copied from FedEx, which delivers the last leg.

entries.wording: Arrived at FedEx hub
entries.note: Copied from FedEx, which delivers the last leg.

entries.wording: 到达收货点
entries.note: The first scan in JRT's hands; GZYL's tenant of the same platform words it "Arrive at the cross border receiving point". The English is Tianhui Hengyuan's and KUN Express's for their arrival on the platform.

entries.wording: 货物离开操作中心
entries.note: GZYL's tenant of the same platform words it "Goods leave the operation center".

entries.wording: 深圳集散中心 已收货
entries.english: Received at the Shenzhen distribution center
entries.note: JRT's hub in Shenzhen received the parcel after it left the operation center elsewhere, before its flight.

entries.wording: 货物打包完成，已发往航司
entries.english: Goods packed and sent to the airline
entries.note: After the parcel left the operation center, before its flight.

entries.wording: 抵达航司已起飞
entries.english: Arrived at the airline, flight departed
entries.note: The flight left the airport the row names.

entries.wording: Shipment arrived at facility
The goods have been packed and sent to the airline
Arriving at the airline, in the process of booking a flight
entries.note: At the airline while a flight is booked.

entries.wording: 货物已交机场,等待航班安排中 Cargo delivered to airport, pending flight arrangement
entries.note: Handed to the airport to wait for a flight. It is not a delivery to the recipient, though the translation reads "delivered".

entries.wording: 货物已交机场,预计…号的航班 Goods delivered to airport, scheduled on flight of the …
entries.note: Handed to the airport, with the day of the flight booked in both halves ("预计11号的航班", "of the 11rd"); the map reads each day as an ellipsis. The flight is still to come, so the row shows its English without it.

entries.wording: 货物已交机场,等待…号的航班起飞 Goods have been delivered to the airport, pending departure on the flight on the …
entries.note: Handed to the airport to wait for the flight whose day both halves name ("等待23号", "on the 23rd."); the map reads each day as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: 报关已放行等待…号航班起飞 Customs released,Awaiting departure on flight of the …
entries.note: Cleared for export, waiting for the flight whose day both halves name ("等待27号航班", "of the 27th"); the map reads each day as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: 航班起飞，以实际抵达为准 Flight departure subject to actual arrival time
航班落地，拆板中 Flight landing, dismantling board in progress
entries.note: Landed; the pallets are broken down before clearance.

entries.wording: 机场内等待提货，等待清关 Waiting for cargo pickup and customs clearance at the airport.
已提货，清关中 The goods have been picked up and are currently undergoing customs clearance
entries.note: Collected from the airport; import clearance is under way.

entries.wording: 清关完成，卡车发运 Customs clearance completed; truck dispatched.
已交服务商 Delivered to service provider
entries.note: Handed to the delivering carrier. It is not a delivery to the recipient, though the translation reads "delivered".

entries.wording: the instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to dhl electronically
entries.note: Copied from DHL, which delivers the last leg: the label's data has reached it. JRT copies DHL's rows in lower case.

entries.wording: shipment in transit to dhl
entries.note: Copied from DHL: the parcel, accepted by JRT, is on its way to DHL, before its flight.

entries.wording: the shipment has been processed in the parcel center of origin
entries.note: Copied from DHL's hub after the hand-off.

entries.wording: unloaded from movement / tour vehicle
entries.note: Copied from DHL.

entries.wording: loaded to movement / tour vehicle
entries.note: Copied from DHL.

entries.wording: pick-up was successful.
entries.note: Copied from DHL: DHL collected the parcel after JRT's hand-over, so it is already on its way.

entries.wording: sorted
entries.note: Copied from DHL, beside the destination's code, within a second of DHL's parcel-centre scan on the same wall clock.

entries.wording: the shipment has been processed in the destination parcel center
entries.note: Copied from DHL's hub near the recipient.

entries.wording: movement / tour vehicle arrived
entries.note: Copied from DHL.

entries.wording: not delivered-consignee could not be reached
entries.note: Copied from DHL: nobody was in.

entries.wording: held for consignee collection
entries.note: Copied from DHL: left at a pickup point for the recipient.

entries.wording: shipment will be returned to origin-not ordered
entries.note: Copied from DHL: the recipient refused it as not ordered, and it goes back.

entries.wording: loaded to movement / tour vehicle(return to sender)
entries.note: Copied from DHL, on the way back to the sender.

entries.wording: unloaded from movement / tour vehicle(return to sender)
entries.note: Copied from DHL, on the way back to the sender.

entries.wording: movement / tour vehicle arrived(return to sender)
entries.note: Copied from DHL, on the way back to the sender.

entries.wording: the shipment has been successfully delivered
entries.note: Copied from DHL. After a return it is the delivery back to the sender, and the parser reads it as returned.

entries.wording: returned shipment has been received by processing center
entries.note: The returned parcel is back at JRT's center.

entries.wording: The instruction data for this shipment have been provided by the sender to DHL electronically.
entries.note: DHL's label data, copied with its case and full stop, before JRT's first scan.

entries.wording: 快件操作完成
entries.note: The English is HuaHan's, whose API documentation gives it for this summary of the departure scan.

entries.wording: Sending to the airport
Arriving at the airport - arranging flights
entries.note: At the airport while a flight is booked.

entries.wording: Flight is expected to take off on …
entries.note: Waiting at the airport for the booked flight, whose day is read as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: Flight has flown
Flight has arrived
Dismantling and picking up goods in progress
entries.note: Landed; the pallets are broken down and the goods collected for clearance.

entries.wording: Customs clearance of the cargo is in progress
Customs clearance completed
The goods have been handed over to the carrier
entries.note: Handed to the carrier that delivers the last leg.

entries.wording: The shipment has been posted by the sender at the retail outlet
entries.note: Copied from DHL: JRT hands the parcel in at a Deutsche Post outlet for the last leg, so the parcel is already on its way.

entries.wording: The flight is expected to depart on … and land on …
entries.note: Waiting at the airport for the booked flight, whose days, month.day, are read as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: The flight has departed and is expected to … land
entries.note: In the air; the landing day, month.day, is read as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: The flight has arrived and is awaiting dismantling
The NOA has been received
entries.note: The airline's notice of arrival, after the landing and before the pickup and customs clearance.

entries.wording: …号航班
entries.note: JRT's own row on its line into the United States, naming the flight's month and day, read as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: 航班延误，预计…号飞出 Flight delayed, estimated departure on …
entries.note: A delayed flight with its new day, month/day and month name day, in both halves; the map reads each day as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: Parcel Information Received
entries.note: A partner's data row in Shenzhen, at the second of JRT's own data row.

entries.wording: Label Created
entries.note: The partner's label, seconds after its data row, before the parcel moves.

entries.wording: 国内清关完成
entries.note: China's export clearance done, before the airport.

entries.wording: Arriving at the airport - arranging flights/到达机场-安排航班中
entries.note: At the airport, waiting for a flight to be booked.

entries.wording: 预计…航班/Flight scheduled for …
entries.note: The flight booked, naming its day in both halves ("预计10.29航班", "October 29th"); the map reads each day as an ellipsis. The flight is still to come.

entries.wording: 航班已启运/Package in transit to destination country
entries.note: The flight left.

entries.wording: 航班已落地，拆板中/Package arrived at destination country
entries.note: The flight landed and its pallets are being broken down, before customs.

entries.wording: 航班已飞
航班抵达
航班已抵达
entries.note: The flight's landing at the European airport the row names.

entries.wording: 清关完成，中转德国中
entries.english: Customs cleared, in transit to Germany
entries.note: Cleared at the airport of arrival and on its way to the hand-over in Germany.

entries.wording: 抵达德国，已交服务商
entries.english: Arrived in Germany, handed to the delivering carrier
entries.note: Handed to the delivering carrier, such as DHL. It is not a delivery to the recipient.

entries.wording: 提货中
entries.note: At the destination airport after the landing, before the clearance.

entries.wording: 清关完成，已提货，待交仓
entries.english: Customs clearance completed, goods picked up, awaiting hand-over to the warehouse

entries.wording: 已交仓
entries.note: The hand-over to the delivering carrier's warehouse, before UPS's first facility scan.

entries.wording: 发件人已创建标签，但是 UPS 尚未收到包裹。
entries.english: Shipper created a label, UPS has not received the package yet.
entries.note: UPS's label row. On the line into the United States the tracker copies UPS's rows in Chinese, on UPS's wall clock at the scan's place; the English is UPS's.

entries.wording: 抵达设施
entries.note: Copied from UPS.

entries.wording: 离开设施
entries.note: Copied from UPS.

entries.wording: 已提取
entries.note: Copied from UPS without a place, between its facility scans; the parcel is already on its way.

entries.wording: UPS 设施处理
entries.note: Copied from UPS.

entries.wording: 已装上递送车辆
entries.note: Copied from UPS, whose own map gives its code OF out for delivery.

entries.wording: 准备今天递送
entries.note: Copied from UPS, whose own map gives its code OT out for delivery.

entries.wording: 已递送
entries.note: Copied from UPS.

entries.wording: Package has been packed and delivered to airport
Domestic customs clearance completed
entries.note: Export clearance in China, before the flight.

entries.wording: Cargo handed over to the airline
Estimated departure is …
entries.note: Names the booked flight's day, read as an ellipsis: "Estimated departure is October 23th".

entries.wording: Estimated arrival date is …
entries.note: Names the booked flight's arrival day, read as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: The flight has taken off
Arrived at Destinated Airport
Arrived at customs clearance warehouse
entries.note: At the destination's customs warehouse after the landing, before the clearance.

entries.wording: In transit to final service provider
entries.note: On the way to the delivering carrier after the clearance.

entries.wording: Delivery to final service provider
entries.note: Handed to the delivering carrier, such as DHL. It is not a delivery to the recipient.

entries.wording: The international shipment has been processed in the parcel center of origin
entries.note: Copied from DHL, whose own adapter reads the same sentence in transit.

entries.wording: The international shipment has been processed in the export parcel center
entries.note: Copied from DHL, whose own adapter reads the same sentence in transit.

entries.wording: The shipment will be transported to the destination country/destination area and, from there, handed over to the delivery organization.
entries.note: Copied from DHL, whose own adapter reads the same sentence in transit.

entries.wording: The shipment has arrived at the parcel center.
entries.note: Copied from DHL, whose own adapter reads the same sentence in transit.

entries.wording: The shipment has been processed in the parcel center
entries.note: Copied from DHL, whose own adapter reads the same sentence in transit.

entries.wording: The shipment is being prepared for delivery in the delivery depot
entries.note: Copied from DHL, whose own adapter reads the same sentence in transit: the depot prepares the round, which has not left.

entries.wording: The shipment could not be delivered. Please find more information here.
entries.note: Copied from DHL, whose own adapter reads the same sentence as a failed attempt. The tracker copies it with DHL's help link, which the scan text leaves out.

entries.wording: 已装柜发车，待抵达新疆
entries.english: Loaded into a container and on its way to Xinjiang
entries.note: On JRT's road line to Europe, the container leaving for Xinjiang, the way out of China, after the Shenzhen distribution center.

entries.wording: Shipping Label Created
entries.note: A partner's label on the line into the United States, before JRT receives the parcel.

entries.wording: En tránsito internacional. Pendiente de recepción en CTT Express
entries.note: CTT Express's notice of a parcel in international transit to it, its code 3900, relayed on the line into Spain.

entries.wording: Pre-clearance completed
entries.note: After the airline's notice of arrival and before the import clearance.

entries.wording: Rerouted to parcel machine., The Recipient of this courier parcel used the free option of dynamic rerouting to the InPost parcel machine. Once the parcel is delivered to the selected machine, the Recipient will receive an e-mail/SMS message containing the details needed to receive the parcel.
entries.note: Copied from InPost on the line into Poland: the recipient sent the courier parcel to a parcel machine, where it has not arrived yet.

entries.wording: Prepared by the Sender., The parcel will soon be handed over to us to reach you as quickly as possible.
entries.note: Copied from InPost: the sender's label, written before JRT's warehouse receives the parcel.

entries.wording: Consignee Contacted
entries.note: A call or message to the recipient, which moves nothing.

entries.wording: Data transferred and received by carrier
entries.note: The parcel's data passed to the carrier, before JRT's receiving point takes the parcel in.

entries.wording: Shipment inbound in sorting center
entries.note: Into the sorting centre that prepares the export, after the receiving point took the parcel in.

entries.wording: Departed from sorting center
entries.note: Out of that sorting centre, on the way to the airport.

entries.wording: Se espera que el vuelo salga hacia … el …
entries.note: Waiting for the booked flight on the line into Mexico; the destination and the flight's day are read as ellipses.

entries.wording: The flight is en route to the airport in …
entries.note: The flight to the destination's airport, which the map reads as an ellipsis.

entries.wording: At local FedEx facility
entries.note: Copied from FedEx, which delivers the last leg: at its station before the delivery run.

entries.wording: On the way, A trusted third-party vendor is on the way with your package.
entries.note: Copied from FedEx's in-transit scan (code IT): a contractor carries the parcel between FedEx's facilities, a day before the local station's scan and the delivery run.
